'''Orm Kreg''' was a member of [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]], who was among [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces, under [[Lane Vizla]], hunting for relics stolen by the [[Hidden Chain]]. Orm was in posession of [[the Buzz]], a self-replenishing [[Stimulant/Legends|stim]] that increased movement speed, but was mauled to death by [[the Scrabbler]].
